## What each track delivers

| Track | Deliverables |
| :--- | :--- |
| `content` | every new visible string as an EN and a PL key in js/i18n.js<br>agent.json, llms.txt, llms-full.txt and the JSON-LD updated when the offer they describe changed<br>sitemap.xml lastmod moved when a listed URL changed |
| `fix` | the reproduction in the commit or pull request body, and how the fix was checked |
| `chore` | nothing beyond a green `npm run verify` |

## Stages

| Stage | Lead skills | Deliverables | Procedure |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1. Plan — Who the change is for, what it claims, and where every claim comes from. A number or client name that cannot be sourced is cut here, not after it ships. | `owner`, `agency`, `pixel`, `documentation` | the plan in the pull request body: what changes on the page, in which language keys, and which machine-readable files follow | `.agents/rules/review.md` |
| 2. Implement — Markup in index.html with data-i18n keys, both languages in js/i18n.js, styles through the existing tokens in css/design-system.css, no new dependency and no build step. | `pixel`, `code_quality`, `security_guard`, `refactor` | — | `.agents/rules/frontend.md` |
| 3. Verify — Runs `npm run verify` and reports its actual output, then the manual checks no script makes: both languages, both themes, phone width, keyboard focus, the contact form against a local PHP server. | `qa`, `debugger` | — | `.agents/workflows/verification.md` |
| 4. Review and ship — Self-review against .agents/rules/review.md, a pull request with a rich description, merge only on green required checks. | `documentation`, `security_guard`, `devops` | a pull request into main with green CI<br>README.md updated when how the site is run or deployed changed | `.agents/workflows/branching.md` |

## Skills and when they lead

Canonical text: `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. Claude Code reads the mirror in `.claude/skills/`,
where the name loses its underscores. Several skills were inherited from a Symfony + React project;
the scope column says which parts apply here.

| Skill | Claude Code | Applies to |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `pixel` | `/pixel` | Layout, typography, tokens, both themes, motion, the anti-AI-slop design doctrine. Its MUI specifics do not apply; the site uses css/design-system.css |
| `agency` | `/agency` | Whether a section earns its place: positioning, clarity of the offer, the path to the contact form |
| `owner` | `/owner` | Reading the page as a buyer with little time: what they get, what it costs them, what to do next |
| `documentation` | `/documentation` | README, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the machine-readable files (agent.json, llms.txt, llms-full.txt). Its Spec Kit artifact list is optional for a site change |
| `code_quality` | `/code-quality` | Readable vanilla JS and PHP. Its Symfony layering sections do not apply |
| `refactor` | `/refactor` | Behaviour-preserving cleanup of js/ and css/, verified with npm run verify before and after |
| `security_guard` | `/security-guard` | contact.php bot defences and header handling, HTML sinks in js/, secrets never committed. Its JWT and multi-tenant sections do not apply |
| `qa` | `/qa` | Manual walk-through of both languages, both themes, phone width and the contact form; npm run verify for what a script can check |
| `debugger` | `/debugger` | Reading the failing check's own output, reproducing in a browser or with php -S before changing code |
| `devops` | `/devops` | Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, .htaccess, GitHub Actions. FrankenPHP, Coolify and Symfony worker notes do not apply |
| `admin` | `/admin` | Inherited from another project; does not apply to this site |
| `event_driven` | `/event-driven` | Inherited from another project; does not apply to this site |
| `migrations` | `/migrations` | Inherited from another project; does not apply to this site |
| `sql_master` | `/sql-master` | Inherited from another project; does not apply to this site |

## Required before a pull request merges

`main` should accept a merge only when these jobs in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` pass.
Branch protection lives in GitHub settings, where no commit can see it.

- Verify site
- Track declared

## Architectural rules, with what enforces each

- Every visible string exists in both languages. Text in index.html carries a data-i18n, data-i18n-html, -placeholder, -title or -aria key, and that key exists under both `en` and `pl` in js/i18n.js, as does every key js/ asks for with APSW_I18N.t(). The two dictionaries hold the same set of keys.
  *Enforced by:* `scripts/check-site.mjs` (keys used exist in en and pl; en and pl key sets match). A literal with no key at all is caught only in review
- Translated markup uses an *_html key on a data-i18n-html element. The language switcher sets textContent for data-i18n, so a tag in a plain key is shown to the visitor as literal text, and a data-i18n element whose children are markup loses them on the first language switch.
  *Enforced by:* `scripts/check-site.mjs` (data-i18n-html keys end in _html; plain keys hold no markup)
- No runtime dependencies and no build step. The files in the repository are the files served. package.json exists only to run checks and declares no dependencies; every script index.html loads is a local file.
  *Enforced by:* `scripts/check-site.mjs` (package.json dependencies, external script sources)
- contact.php is the only server code, and it keeps every defence it has: POST only, the two honeypot fields, the two-second time trap on form_rendered_at, the per-IP rate limit, and length validation. The form in index.html keeps the matching fields. It has no CSRF token today, whatever its header comment says: adding one is a fix, and no copy may claim one until it exists.
  *Enforced by:* `scripts/check-site.mjs` (php -l, defence markers in contact.php, matching form fields); review for anything new
- No HTML sink receives untrusted input. innerHTML is for strings this repository wrote (translations, static snippets); anything from the network or the visitor goes through textContent. eval, new Function, document.write and string timers are banned in js/.
  *Enforced by:* `scripts/check-site.mjs` (banned APIs); review for innerHTML
- Machine-readable files stay valid and agree with the page. agent.json and every JSON-LD block parse as JSON, sitemap.xml is well-formed and lists only absolute https://apsw.pl URLs, and llms.txt starts with its H1. When the offer on the page changes, they change in the same pull request.
  *Enforced by:* `scripts/check-site.mjs` (validity); review for agreement
- Every in-page link lands somewhere. Each href="#id" in index.html has a matching id.
  *Enforced by:* `scripts/check-site.mjs`
- No invented metrics in new copy. A number, client, certification or outcome added to the page, the JSON-LD or the llms files is one the owner can source. Prefer a plain statement to an impressive one that cannot be defended.
  *Enforced by:* review (.agents/rules/review.md)
